# Props catalog (generated by `node Engine/scripts/props_catalog.mjs`; do not edit by hand)
Import with `import {Name} from '@engine/<dir>/<file>'`. Every prop is toon-lit and inked; most also take pos, rot,
scale, seed (left out below). Read the source only for the
ones you use. New reusable props go in the matching theme file (or a new `props/<era-or-theme>.tsx` with a header
comment), then re-run this script.

## props/basic
- **Ink**(t=0.025, shadowMul=2)
- **Barrel**(label, labelStyle='stencil', wood='#A86A3A', open, content) — barrel (lathe + staves texture + iron hoops)
- **Crate**(size=[0.9, 0.8, 0.9], wood='#B98A52', label) — crate
- **Deck**(size=[12, 30], wood='#B07A48', planks=10) — planked deck / floor
- **Railing**(length=8, height=1.0, wood='#7A4A26', spacing=0.35) — railing (posts + top rail + balusters)
- **Cannon**(recoil=0) — cannon
- **Sign**(text, sub, style='painted', w=2, h=0.8, board=true, color, bg, glow=0) — hanging / standing sign
- **Lantern**(color='#FFC46B', swing=0.06) — lantern (emissive, flicker) — ambient motion
- **RopeCoil**() — rope coil
- **SeaStack**(height=30, radius=7, colors=['#C98A5A', '#B57…) — sea stack / rock spire with strata (backdrop)

## props/dutch
Dutch-countryside props (polder, dikes, windmills, sluices, barges) — every mesh toon-lit + plum ink (style-bible §3.1). First used by Projects/01_dutch-water-line. Generic enough for any lowland / river / farm story.
- **Polder**(size=[80, 80], rows=10, colors, tile=20) — ground: polder field (plane with crop rows + ditches)
- **Ground**(size=[200, 200], color, kind='grass', tile=8) — Plain grass / snow / mud ground plane.
- **Dike**(length=30, height=1.6, top=2.2, base=6, color='#78B548', breach=0, path=true) — dike: long trapezoid embankment, grass top, along local x
- **Windmill**(speed=0.035, body='#5E4A3A', sail='#F2E6CF') — windmill (sails turn every frame = ambient motion)
- **Tree**(height=3, crown='#4E9A3A', sunk=0, kind='round') — tree → nature.LeafyTree (painted leaf clusters, sway)
- **FencePosts**(count=8, spacing=1.4, height=1.1, rails=true) — Row of fence posts along local x (half under water in the flood sets).
- **Barn**(w=6, d=5, h=3) — barn (brick walls, thatched roof, big doors)
- **Placard**(text, sub, w=1.2, h=1.5) — Nailed paper placard (text in the period paper style) — the "poster" beat.
- **SluiceGate**(open=0, wheel=0, width=2.4) — sluice gate (stone piers, wooden gate that lifts, turning wheel)
- **Rowboat**(tilt=0, color='#6A4A9A') — Rowboat (keeled hull). tilt = grounded list in radians.
- **GunBarge**(length=4.2, flag='#F08A24') — Flat-bottomed Dutch gun barge: shallow box hull, small cannon, orange flag.
- **WaterSlab**(size=[12, 0.5, 8], color='#6CC0DE', deep='#2A6E9E', opacity=0.55)
- **MudBlock**(size=[12, 1.2, 8])
- **DepthRuler**(height=1.4, mark=0.26, label='KNEE-DEEP', glow=0, labelX=-0.62, labelW=0.95) — Big painted depth ruler post with a "KNEE-DEEP" marker at `mark` (world units above its base). glow = burst on the reveal word.
- **Tent**(a='#F4EFEA', b='#F08A24', size=2.2) — Striped army tent (pyramid).
- **Skyline**(count=14, width=40) — Row of Dutch gabled canal-house fronts + a church spire (distant skyline card, inked).
- **HandPump**(pump=0) — Hand pump (wooden post, iron spout, handle angle `pump` in radians).
- **Cow**(graze=0) — Simple toon cow (Holstein patches) — easter-egg life on the farm.
- **Bubbles**(center=[0, 0.3, 0], size=[6, 0.5, 2], count=18) — Bubbles rising out of water (ambient motion in the cross-section).

## props/nature
NATURE DRESSING — reusable detail for ANY outdoor set (look-dev 2026-11-06: "never flat, never bare"). Instanced grass that sways, flowers, reeds, leafy trees with painted leaf clusters, bushes, rocks, lily pads, a duck, and hazy backdrop layers (tree lines, hills) for depth. Every solid gets toon light + plum ink. Usage rule (style-bible §3.2b): every exterior set gets ≥ 1 ground-cover layer (Gr…
- **leafTex**() — painted leaf texture (scalloped clumps + ink strokes)
- **LeafyTree**(height=3.2, crown='#4E9A3A', spread=1.4, clusters=14, sunk=0, sway=1, kind='round') — leafy tree (many inked leaf clusters, slow sway)
- **Bush**(color='#5BA544', size=0.8, flowers) — Low round bush (3–6 leaf clusters) — foreground / midground filler. Optional flowers dotted on top.
- **GrassField**() — Thousands of swaying grass tufts (3 crossed blades each), colour-varied. `clear` keeps paths / actor spots open.
- **Flowers**() — Scattered little flowers (stem-less heads on the grass): colour pops in the midground.
- **Reeds**() — Reeds + cattails along a water edge (instanced, swaying).
- **Rocks**(count=5, spread=1.2, color='#9A9488', size=0.25) — Chunky inked rocks / pebbles.
- **LilyPads**(count=7, spread=2, y=0) — Lily pads (+ the odd pink flower) floating on a water surface at height y.
- **Duck**(y, drift=0.004) — A paddling duck (easter-egg life): bobs, drifts along x.
- **TreeLine**(length=120, count=40, color='#4F8A3A', height=4) — Long row of distant trees (silhouette-ish, hazed by fog) along local x.
- **Hills**(width=400, height=18, color='#6FA85A', bumps=7) — Rolling hills band (painted gradient, inked ridge), pushed far back; layer 2–3 of these with fog for aerial perspective.

## props/tower
Shot-tower props: lantern-lit shaft CUT-AWAY (rock strata + brick-lined shaft + water basin), perforated sieve, falling LEAD DROPS (hot glow -> silver, lumpy -> sphere, ripples where they land), the HERO DROP that snaps from a lumpy blob into a perfect sphere (surface tension), tension arrows, depth ruler. First used by Projects/02_shot-tower. Generic for any vertical cut-away / falling-liquid /…
- **SHAFT_DEFAULTS** (value)
- **ShaftCutaway**(h=SHAFT_DEFAULTS.h, hw=SHAFT_DEFAULTS.hw, hd=SHAFT_DEFAULTS.hd, chamberHw=SHAFT_DEFAULTS.ch…, chamberH=SHAFT_…)
- **Sieve**(radius=0.8, holes=7, glow=1, pour=[-1e9, 1e9]) — sieve (perforated pan with a glowing sheet of molten lead)
- **LeadDrops**(from, poolY, area=[1.3, 1.1], count=22, period=56, on=[-1e9, 1e9], radius=0.1, lumpUntil=0.62, coolAt=0.5) — Stream of silver lead drops: born glowing + lumpy at the sieve, round and silver by the time they hit the water, with a ripple ring + tiny splash cro…
- **HeroDrop**(at, radius=0.34, snap, cool=snap + 40, coolLen=12, arrows=[snap - 56, snap])
- **HoistRope**(length=6, sway=0.05) — Hoist rope with a wooden bucket hanging in the shaft (foreground element that sways; blurred by DOF when near the lens).

## props/town
Old-town props: tiled roofs, chimneys, crenellated roof decks, iron pot + tripod, molten lead streams, row houses with balconies, a Gothic tower that BUILDS block by block (+ ghost Abbey silhouette), church, cobbles, workshop / yard / counting-house furniture, furnace, calendar, patent scroll, coin sacks, tilted test table, clock, rock chips, and the easter-egg animals (cat, pigeon, rat). First u…
- **TileRoof**(w=4, d=3, rise=1.3, color='#B5553C') — Pitched tile roof (gable along x). w = along ridge, d = depth of the footprint, pitch = rise.
- **Chimney**(h=1.6, pots=2) — Brick chimney with pots; optional smoke.
- **RoofDeck**(size=[14.4, 3.2], stone='#B9A98C') — Crenellated roof deck slab with a parapet along the front (+z) and the right (+x) edges.
- **IronPot**(tilt=0, glow=1) — iron pot on a tripod (+ molten pour)
- **Tripod**(h=1.1)
- **LeadStream**(from, rod=0.8, fall=12, on=[-1e9, 1e9], radius=0.07, count=16, drift=[0.2, 0, 0], width=0.05) — A stream of molten lead pouring from `from`: glowing rod for the first `rod` units, then drops that fall (and cool) for `fall` units.
- **Cat**() — animals (easter eggs)
- **Pigeon**()
- **Rat**()
- **Furnace**() — furnace room
- **Jar**(label='ARSENIC', color='#9DBF8A')
- **Table**(size=[2, 0.9, 1], wood='#8A5A30', legs=true)
- **RowHouse**(w=3.2, floors=3, wall='#E9C98A', roof='#B5553C', door=true, balconies=[]) — Row house front: plaster body, door, windows, optional balcony per window, tiled gable roof + chimney. Front faces +z.
- **GothicTower**(w=3.0, h=9, build=1, adorn=1, courses=9, sign=false) — Gothic tower. build 0..1 stacks the stone courses block by block; adorn 0..1 pops the pointed windows, buttresses, pinnacles and spire.
- **AbbeyGhost**(glow=1, w=9)
- **Church**()
- **Cobbles**(size=[40, 30], tint='#B8AC98')
- **Lamppost**()
- **PipeRack**() — workshop / yard / counting house
- **ShotTray**(lumpy=true, roll=1e9, n=14) — Tray of lead shot. lumpy = dented blobs; one ball (idx 0) can roll off (`roll` frame start).
- **WallCalendar**(from='1781', to, flip) — Wall calendar: pages flip (hinged at the top). year/age: `flip` frame flips the top page to reveal `to`.

- **Desk**()
- **Ledger**(text='10,000')
- **CoinSack**(mark='£')

- **TiltedTable**(start=0, round=6, angle=0.22) — Test table, tilted down to +x. Balls roll off in a neat line (round ones) — `lumpyAt` stops one wobbling.
- **Clock**(period=70)
- **Chips**(period=20, count=12, color='#B97A47', on=[-1e9, 1e9], speed=1) — Rock chips flying out of a spot every `period` frames (digging).
- **Pickaxe**() — Pickaxe prop (stand-alone: leaned on a wall / lying).
- **Room**(w=9, d=7, h=3.6, wall='brick', wallColor='#B8704E', floor='planks', floorColor='#9A6A3C', windows=[], windowY…) — interior room (floor, 3 walls, ceiling beams, windows, hanging lanterns)

## props/world
WORLD PROPS — generic, reusable set pieces for any story (first used by 01_dutch-water-line): Crowd (instanced marching/standing army or crowd, inked), FloodSheet (water spreading over land), IceSheet (freezes, cracks, breaks into floes), WaterArc (pumped/poured water), Snow, CrackedGround (drought mud), Fish, Backdrop (hills + tree line + clouds in one line — the "never an empty horizon" layer).
- **Crowd**(center=[0, 0, 0], rows=6, cols=12, spacing=[0.9, 0.9], dir=[1, 0], speed=0, start=-1e9, stop=1e9, body=['#3E5…)
- **FloodSheet**(center=[0, 0, 0], radius, color='#5FB4DA', y=0.04, stretch=[1, 1]) — radius(f) → current radius; rim of foam; ticks. Use for breaches, rising floods, spills.
- **IceSheet**(center=[0, 0, 0], size=[30, 30], y=0.27, freeze=1, crack=0, brk=0)
- **WaterArc**(from, vel, on=[-1e9, 1e9], count=70, color='#9ADCF5', spread=0.012) — WaterArc: droplets along a parabola (pump spout, bucket pour)
- **Snow**(center=[0, 4, 0], size=[16, 8, 16], count=220, on=-1e9) — Snow: falling flakes in a box around a centre
- **CrackedGround**(size=[60, 60], color='#C99A62', tile=6) — CrackedGround: drought mud plates with inked cracks
- **Fish**(color='#F2A33A', flop=false) — Little toon fish (flopping on dry mud, or swimming).
- **Backdrop**(center=[0, 0, 0], facing=0, near='#7FAE6A', far='#93A9C9', trees='#4F8A3A', cloudTint='#FFF6E8', cloudShadow=…) — Drop into any exterior set so the horizon is never empty. `facing` rotates the whole backdrop (radians, about y).

## world/Sky
- **SkyDome**(mood, radius=900) — Gradient sky dome + sun/moon disc with glow + stars.
- **cloudTexture**(number) — Puffy cartoon cumulus cloud (soft shading, flat bottom, no outline) drawn once per seed.
- **Clouds**(clouds, tint='#FFFFFF', shadow='#C9D8F0', opacity=1) — Puffy 3D clouds that drift slowly (ambient motion).

## world/Water
- **Water**(size=2000, y=0, near='#0E5C9A', far='#3FC6D6', tickScale=26, speed=1, reflect)
- **FoamRing**(radius=1) — Animated foam ring around a floating object.

## fx/particles
- **Motes**(center=[0, 2, 0], size=[10, 4, 10], count=60, color='#FFF4D0') — Floating dust / pollen motes catching the light — near-camera depth cue, always moving.
- **Gulls**(center=[0, 25, -60], radius=14, count=5) — Flock of ink-line seagulls circling far away (sky ambient motion).
- **Embers**(count=30, spread=1, rise=3, color='#FFB040') — Rising embers / sparks (fire, forge, cannon).
- **SmokePuffs**(count=8, rate=10, color='#EDEDED', rise=3, size=1, drift=[0.4, 0, 0], start=-9999) — Cartoon smoke puffs (chimney, cannon, steam): grow, rise, fade.
- **Flag**(w=1.6, h=1, map, color='#1E1612') — Waving cloth flag (vertex-animated plane).
